_comment: The add-ons the ewe payload carries (plan D1-D3; docs/PLUGINS.md 'Add-ons'). Written by scripts/vendor-plugins.sh, read by bin/ewe-plugin: `default` ids are seeded on every machine, `migrate` ids are installed once for upgraders who had the feature built in, everything else is installed with `ewe-plugin install <id>` (Komble -> Add-ons, the Welcome screen).
